title: Prophecy about Egypt and future unity
description: A comprehensive prophecy in which the Lord comes to Egypt and the idols tremble. God stirs Egyptians against Egyptians, dries up the Nile, and confuses Pharaoh's advisors. The prophecy ends with the Egyptians coming to know the Lord, an altar being built in Egypt, and Egypt, Assyria, and Israel being blessed together as God's people.
